AI Implementation Pattern

AI Does The Intake, A Person Approves The Next Step

The automation model pauses before anything important is confirmed. AI qualifies the lead and drafts a next action, then a person approves, edits, or rejects it.

Ad Or Outreach AI Qualifies Lead Human Approval Route To Follow-Up

Lead Engines

Two Acquisition Channels

01

Insurance Customer Engine

Runs paid ads, local content, referral links, and landing pages for people looking for protection.

  • Family protection offer
  • Mortgage protection offer
  • Business continuity offer
02

Sales Agent Recruiting Engine

Runs recruiting campaigns for people curious about insurance sales, licensing, and agency opportunity.

  • Career change audience
  • Licensed agent audience
  • Part-time opportunity audience
03

AI Qualification Layer

Reads the conversation, identifies intent, scores fit, and drafts the recommended next step.

  • Intent classification
  • Lead scoring
  • Next-step recommendation
04

Human Approval Gate

Pauses automation before outreach, appointment confirmation, or recruiting follow-up.

  • Review AI summary
  • Approve or reject
  • Route to the right workflow
